entities.name: Héctor García Otero
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Héctor García Otero was a Uruguayan basketball player, who twice won the bronze medal with the men's national team at the Summer Olympics: in 1952 and 1956. García died in Montevideo on 20 August 1999, at the age of 73.
